Yes, they sent her back for a different date and now we have to visit the office, again, with the said documents.

My questions to this office is -
1. Are you not aware that it is part of a little bit of decency to answer questions from the applicants?
2. Why do you not explain in simple and clear language to senior citizens, as to what they should be getting and WHY they should be getting it? Passbook with a photo and a transaction from the same day as of the appointment?

Documents required : Carry all below original as well.
1. Application Receipt
2. Old passport copy
3. Aadhar copy (full original aadhar)
4. Digilocker linked with Aadhar

Since my address was same as before that's why only only these 3 was sufficient. P.S. There is a xerox guy inside if you forgot anything.

Pro Tip: Upload your documents through Digilocker in Passport Seva website.  This helped me because they didn't even check my originals. I had also linked my 10th Marksheet just for the safe side to avoid the Non-ECR Document.

I received my passport within 5 days. I'm amazed. Now Police Verification in 2 weeks as per last message.
